en: convert a CSV, YAML or XML file to JSON / JSON Lines
uz: CSV, YAML yoki XML faylni JSON / JSON Lines'ga aylantirish

en:
Reads a CSV / TSV, YAML or XML file and writes its records to OUTPUT as JSON Lines (default) or as
one JSON array. The input type comes from the extension (.csv .tsv .yaml .yml .xml) or --from, the
output format from the OUTPUT extension (.json / .jsonl) or --to / --jsonl. Number texts are kept
exactly (1.10 never changes, 007 stays a string). The original file is never modified; the output
may not be the input or a file with unsaved edits. CSV and XML are streamed; YAML is read into
memory whole (a warning above 256 MiB).
uz:
CSV / TSV, YAML yoki XML faylni o'qib, yozuvlarini JSON Lines (standart) yoki bitta JSON massiv
sifatida OUTPUT ga yozadi. Kirish turi kengaytmadan (.csv .tsv .yaml .yml .xml) yoki --from dan,
natija formati OUTPUT kengaytmasidan (.json / .jsonl) yoki --to / --jsonl dan olinadi. Sonlar
matni aynan saqlanadi (1.10 o'zgarmaydi, 007 matn qoladi). Asl fayl o'zgarmaydi; natija kirish
fayli yoki saqlanmagan o'zgarishlari bor fayl bo'la olmaydi. CSV va XML oqim bilan o'qiladi; YAML
butunlay xotiraga o'qiladi (256 MiB dan katta bo'lsa ogohlantiradi).

en:
Examples:
  jsonreshape import data.csv data.jsonl
  jsonreshape import data.csv data.json --indent 4
  jsonreshape import table.tsv -o table.jsonl --no-header --types string
  jsonreshape import export.csv -o export.jsonl --delimiter ";" --encoding cp1251 --skip-bad
  jsonreshape import config.yaml config.json
  jsonreshape import catalog.xml -o catalog.jsonl --record-tag item
  jsonreshape import catalog.xml -o catalog.jsonl --record-path catalog/books/book --json

Rules: the CSV header names the columns (a.b.c becomes nested objects; --no-nest); an empty cell is
null (--empty string); in XML attributes are "@name", text is "#text", repeated elements arrays.
Exit codes: 0 - written; 1 - an invalid option (OUTPUT is the input itself, an unknown type, pyyaml
not installed); 2 - the input is malformed (the line and the reason are shown); 3 - cancelled.
uz:
Misollar:
  jsonreshape import data.csv data.jsonl
  jsonreshape import data.csv data.json --indent 4
  jsonreshape import jadval.tsv -o jadval.jsonl --no-header --types string
  jsonreshape import eksport.csv -o eksport.jsonl --delimiter ";" --encoding cp1251 --skip-bad
  jsonreshape import config.yaml config.json
  jsonreshape import katalog.xml -o katalog.jsonl --record-tag item
  jsonreshape import katalog.xml -o katalog.jsonl --record-path catalog/books/book --json

Qoidalar: CSV sarlavhasi ustun nomlari (a.b.c ichma-ich obyekt bo'ladi; --no-nest); bo'sh katak null
(--empty string); XML'da atribut "@nom", matn "#text", takror elementlar massiv.
Chiqish kodlari: 0 - yozildi; 1 - noto'g'ri parametr (OUTPUT kirish faylining o'zi, noma'lum tur,
pyyaml o'rnatilmagan); 2 - kirish fayli buzuq (qator va sabab ko'rsatiladi); 3 - bekor qilindi.

en: input file: .csv, .tsv, .yaml, .yml or .xml (--from for another extension or for - standard input)
uz: kirish fayli: .csv, .tsv, .yaml, .yml yoki .xml (boshqa kengaytma yoki - standart kirish uchun --from)

en: output file: .jsonl (JSON Lines) or .json (one array); must not be the input
uz: natija fayli: .jsonl (JSON Lines) yoki .json (bitta massiv); kirish fayli bo'lishi mumkin emas

en: input type (default: auto - from the extension)
output format (default: from the OUTPUT extension; else jsonl, json for YAML)
uz: natija formati (standart: OUTPUT kengaytmasidan; aks holda jsonl, YAML uchun json)
JSON Lines yozish (--to jsonl bilan bir xil)

en: values: auto - a cell that is a JSON number becomes a number, true/false/null those values, the rest strings (default); string - everything a string
uz: qiymatlar: auto - JSON son ko'rinishidagi katak son, true/false/null - shunday qiymat, qolgani matn (standart); string - hammasi matn

en: an empty CSV cell: null (default) or string (an empty string)
uz: bo'sh CSV katak: null (standart) yoki string (bo'sh matn)

en: CSV delimiter: one character or tab (default: detected from the start of the file: , ; tab |)
uz: CSV ajratuvchisi: bitta belgi yoki tab (standart: fayl boshidan aniqlanadi: , ; tab |)

en: the first row is not a header: the columns are named c1..cN
uz: birinchi qator sarlavha emas: ustunlar c1..cN deb nomlanadi

en: do not turn column names like a.b.c into nested objects (they stay flat keys)
uz: a.b.c ko'rinishidagi ustun nomlarini ichma-ich obyekt qilmaslik (tekis kalit qoladi)

en: CSV encoding, e.g. cp1251 (default: detected: UTF-8 with or without BOM, UTF-16 with a BOM)
uz: CSV kodirovkasi, masalan cp1251 (standart: aniqlanadi: UTF-8 BOM bilan/BOMsiz, UTF-16 BOM bilan)

en: skip malformed CSV rows (another number of fields, a quoting error) instead of stopping
uz: buzuq CSV qatorlarni (maydonlar soni boshqa, tirnoq xatosi) o'tkazib yuborish; aks holda xato

en: XML: the elements with this tag become the records (default: the children of the root)
uz: XML: shu tegli elementlar yozuv bo'ladi (standart: ildiz elementining bolalari)

en: XML: the path of the record elements from the root, e.g. catalog/books/book
uz: XML: yozuv elementlarining yo'li ildizdan, masalan catalog/books/book
